meta.name: Dabba Cartel
meta.description: When an investigation into a pharma company hits close to home, five women launch a tiffin service with a secret ingredient.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At a society party, the staff of VivaLife Pharma learns about a drug scandal. Raji and Mala go property hunting to operate their tiffin business.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Sheila revisits her past. Preeti questions Shahida as Pathak travels to Amritsar for an investigation. A missing item causes an altercation with Chavan.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Varuna's Sitara is running into losses. Sheila and Chavan strike a deal as she hatches a plan with Moushumi on the side. Raji's Kitchen takes off.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Varuna receives a lucrative opportunity while Pathak makes a breakthrough in his investigation. Hari and Shankar devise ways to handle the Modella stock.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Varuna and Shankar get into an argument. A South American drug presents new opportunities. The women unite to pull out of their current predicament.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Bhowmick and Raji work together to create a “sweet” new drug. More details emerge about VivaLife's trials while a new threat to the cartel arises.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Raji and Sheila are at odds about their future. Preeti and Pathak make a startling discovery. Chacko has an offer for the gang.
